languages.description: Languages to configure. Select them from the prompt or pass comma-separated codes. The first language becomes the default. Dictionaries load from public/i18n/{id}.json by default.

x-prompt.message: Which languages should this app support? Select all that apply.

detectBrowser.description: On the visitor's first visit, choose a language from their browser settings. A saved language choice always takes priority.

x-prompt.message: Use the visitor's browser language on their first visit? A saved choice still takes priority.

project.description: Angular CLI project name — only for multi-app workspaces. Defaults to the workspace default project.
